title: Astronomers Just Found the First Green Star
description:
Astronomers say they've found the first known green star: a white dwarf, WD J1330+6435, whose atmosphere took in sodium, calcium and lithium from the rocky remains of its own planets.
Dense sodium soaks up yellow, orange and some red light, so the team's models show it glowing chartreuse green. They also found a pink, carbon-coloured white dwarf that may be the reddest star ever recorded.
